_about: Hand-kept RESALE reference prices (SGD) for Simplified Chinese sealed product. There is no official Singapore retail price for Chinese product, so these are what a box realistically resells for locally (set to the cheapest few current Carousell asks). Edit the prices when the market moves; add one entry per name sellers commonly use for the same product. A listing alerts when its price is at or below deal_pct of the reference.
